revised_comments: Malawi's National Data Exchange Platform (Boma Lathu) is preparing for, rather than currently deploying, AI integration. The National Data Centre that underpins the platform is being upgraded to an 'AI-ready state' under the World Bank-funded Digital Malawi Acceleration Project, and the Ministry of Information and Communications Technology has delivered high-level AI training for Principal Secretaries, with intended use cases including fraud detection, predictive analytics for policy planning and automation of administrative tasks. AI capability within the data exchange is therefore at the planning stage, with no functional deployment yet documented.
